meta.name: baoyu-markdown-to-html
meta.description: Converts Markdown to styled HTML with WeChat-compatible themes. Supports code highlighting, math, Mermaid (rendered to PNG via headless Chrome), PlantUML, footnotes, alerts, infographics, and optional bottom citations for external links. Use when user asks for "markdown to html", "convert md to html", "md 转 html", "微信外链转底部引用", or needs styled HTML output from markdown.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Markdown 转为带微信主题的 HTML
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把 Markdown 文档转为适合微信发布的 HTML
copy.tagline_en: Convert Markdown to styled HTML with WeChat themes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to convert Markdown to HTML for WeChat publication

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以将 Markdown 文件转换为带样式的 HTML，支持代码高亮、数学公式、Mermaid 图表（转为 PNG）、PlantUML、脚注、提示框、信息图，以及将外部链接转为底部引用。
howto.when: 当用户要求“markdown to html”、“convert md to html”、“md 转 html”、“微信外链转底部引用”，或需要从 Markdown 生成带样式的 HTML 时触发。

say.text: 把这篇 Markdown 文章转成 HTML，主题用 grace。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并生成对应主题的 HTML。

say.text: 将我的笔记.md 转为 HTML，并启用底部引用。
say.note: Claude 会转换并处理外部链接到底部引用。

say.text: 帮我转换这个 Markdown 文件，主题用 modern，颜色用红色。
say.note: Claude 会应用 modern 主题和红色主色。

howto.what_en: Converts Markdown to styled HTML with inline CSS, supporting code highlighting, math, Mermaid (rendered to PNG via headless Chrome), PlantUML, footnotes, alerts, infographics, and optional bottom citations for external links.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks for "markdown to html", "convert md to html", "md 转 html", "微信外链转底部引用", or needs styled HTML output from markdown.

say_en.text: Convert this Markdown article to HTML with the grace theme.
say_en.note: Claude will read the file and generate HTML with the grace theme.

say_en.text: Convert my notes.md to HTML with bottom citations enabled.
say_en.note: Claude will convert and move external links to bottom references.

say_en.text: Convert this Markdown file with modern theme and red color.
say_en.note: Claude will apply modern theme and red primary color.
